history.event: Owner authorized Phase 8 design exploration; Phase 7 human/publication gates carried forward as mandatory V1 blockers.
Owner requested Android correction; stable touch viewport, native pinch zoom, responsive navigation and mobile hero-card interaction refinements implemented on the live-site baseline branch.
Owner reported the foundation radial animation was compressed on Android. Mobile frame now centers and magnifies the shared desktop radial SVG without changing desktop styling or animation behavior.

Owner requested softer left/right ends on the mobile foundation animation and correction of the doubled lower fade. Added mobile edge fades and replaced mask-based section fade with layered gradient fades for dark/light themes.

Owner clarified that the animation artwork itself was correct and the Android frame was tinting it dark before fading to purple. Removed colored mobile overlays, restored the shared desktop section background/mask, and switched the cropped visual to transparent alpha-only side fading.

Owner reported that the lower boundary of the mobile foundation artwork still ended as a hard line before a disconnected fade. Extended the visual frame below the unchanged SVG and added a continuous alpha fade that overlaps its lower halo.

Owner requested a project-detail animation for AetherFlow and readable contrast in light theme. Enabled the existing Trigger → Worker → Commit motion scene in the case-study hero, preserved the real desktop screenshot as a separate interface capture, and strengthened AetherFlow light-theme scene contrast.

Owner reported uneven spacing among About, Projects, Novels, Stack, and Contact in the Android header. Replaced the narrow-screen content-sized navigation row with five equal-width grid columns and centered labels.

Owner reported that the narrow mobile product screenshot captures intercept scrolling and make it difficult to continue down the project detail page. Added invisible outer side gutters for document scrolling while retaining a centered independent inner image scroller.

Owner reported that AuraPulse's one-row candle strip and unrelated line did not represent the product, and GlobalCart's abstract mini-scene did not match the marketplace. Rebuilt both compact homepage scenes as a multi-row simulated trading terminal and a miniature product storefront.

Owner approved the AuraPulse and GlobalCart mini-scene redesign and requested the same product-specific treatment for all remaining project cards. Rebuilt AetherFlow, Orbit, Pooya OS, Nexus Canvas, LuminaGlass and Salon Booking compact scenes.

Owner requested replacing the Salon Booking homepage Projects-card image, which showed the lower/full-page site, with an image from the top of the site. Updated the card to use the immutable Shayan Salon hero asset and left case-study gallery captures unchanged.
